content: <thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 120.0423 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value and matches the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 8 % from four carbons). Therefore the molecular formula is C₄H₈O₄.
